# Chart values

Every value of the protem Helm chart in deploy/helm/protem, with its default and description. Generated from the chart's values.yaml and its comments.

<!-- generated by `make docs-reference`; do not edit -->

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image.repository` | `ghcr.io/illeniumstudios/protem` | Operator image. |
| `image.tag` | `""` | Defaults to "v" followed by the chart's appVersion. |
| `image.pullPolicy` | `IfNotPresent` | Image pull policy of the operator and auth proxy containers. |
| `imagePullSecrets` | `[]` | Secrets for pulling the images, e.g. [{name: regcred}]. |
| `agent.image.repository` | `ghcr.io/illeniumstudios/protem-agent` | Agent image the UI puts in the install files for target clusters (--agent-image). |
| `agent.image.tag` | `""` | Defaults to "v" followed by the chart's appVersion. |
| `agent.manifests` | `""` | Kustomize location of the agent manifests the UI's install files use (--agent-manifests). Defaults to https://github.com/iLLeniumStudios/protem//config/agent/spoke?ref=v<appVersion>. |
| `oidc.issuerURL` | `""` | Issuer of the ID tokens the operator accepts (--oidc-issuer-url). |
| `oidc.clientID` | `""` | Audience (client ID) the ID tokens must carry (--oidc-client-id). |
| `hubClusterName` | `local` | Name of the TargetCluster that stands for the cluster the operator runs on (--hub-cluster-name). |
| `hubAPIURL` | `""` | The hub's Kubernetes API URL as agents on target clusters reach it; needed to connect agents from the UI (--hub-api-url). |
| `subjectTemplate` | `""` | Maps a login to an RBAC subject, e.g. "oidc:{{.Email}}"; empty uses the operator's default "{{.Email}}" (--subject-template). |
| `uiManagement` | `readonly` | "readonly", or "enabled" to let the UI manage AccessProfiles and TargetClusters (also installs the role that allows it). |
| `historyRetention` | `""` | Delete finished requests and their grants this long after their last audit event, e.g. 720h; empty keeps them forever. |
| `joinTokenTTL` | `""` | How long a join token issued in the UI works, from 10m to 1h; empty uses the operator's default of 15m. |
| `signOutURL` | `""` | URL the UI opens to sign out; empty hides the link, or uses /oauth2/sign_out when authProxy.enabled. |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | Extra command-line arguments for the operator. |
| `hubAllowedRoles` | `["view","edit"]` | The only roles the operator may bind on the hub cluster itself; empty installs no such permission. |
| `hubCluster.register` | `true` | Create the TargetCluster named hubClusterName, so access can be granted on the hub itself. An existing one that Helm does not manage is left alone, and helm uninstall keeps it. |
| `hubCluster.displayName` | `Hub cluster` | Display name of that TargetCluster. |
| `hubCluster.labels` | `{}` | Labels of that TargetCluster, which profiles select clusters by, e.g. {env: prod}. |
| `replicaCount` | `1` | Operator replicas; above 1 turns on leader election. |
| `resources` | `{"limits":{"cpu":"500m","memory":"128Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"10m","memory":"64Mi"}}` | Resources of the operator container. |
| `nodeSelector` | `{}` | Node selector of the operator pod. |
| `tolerations` | `[]` | Tolerations of the operator pod. |
| `affinity` | `{}` | Affinity of the operator pod. |
| `podAnnotations` | `{}` | Extra annotations on the operator pod. |
| `serviceAccount.annotations` | `{}` | Annotations on the operator's ServiceAccount. |
| `podSecurityContext` | `{"runAsNonRoot":true,"seccompProfile":{"type":"RuntimeDefault"}}` | Security context of the operator pod. |
| `securityContext` | `{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false,"capabilities":{"drop":["ALL"]}}` | Security context of the operator and auth proxy containers. |
| `authProxy.enabled` | `false` | Run oauth2-proxy next to the operator as the only way into the UI and API. See docs/guides/how-to-set-up-login.md. |
| `authProxy.image` | `quay.io/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy:v7.12.0` | oauth2-proxy image. |
| `authProxy.issuerURL` | `""` | Issuer the proxy logs users in with; defaults to oidc.issuerURL. |
| `authProxy.clientID` | `""` | Client ID the proxy logs users in with; defaults to oidc.clientID. |
| `authProxy.publicURL` | `""` | Public URL of the UI, e.g. https://protem.example.com; the IdP redirects to <publicURL>/oauth2/callback. |
| `authProxy.existingSecret` | `""` | Secret with the keys client-secret and cookie-secret. |
| `authProxy.scope` | `""` | OAuth scopes the proxy requests (--scope); empty uses oauth2-proxy's default "openid email profile". Microsoft Entra ID needs offline_access added. |
| `authProxy.extraArgs` | `[]` | Extra command-line arguments for oauth2-proxy, e.g. --allowed-group=... |
| `ingress.enabled` | `false` | Create an Ingress for the UI Service. |
| `ingress.className` | `""` | IngressClass to use; empty uses the cluster's default. |
| `ingress.host` | `""` | Host name of the UI. |
| `ingress.tls.secretName` | `""` | Secret with the TLS certificate for the host; empty serves plain HTTP. |
| `ingress.annotations` | `{}` | Annotations on the Ingress, e.g. cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer. |
| `networkPolicy.enabled` | `false` | Admit traffic to the operator pod only on the UI port and, from namespaces labelled metrics=enabled, the metrics port. |
| `metrics.enabled` | `true` | Serve metrics over HTTPS on :8443, readable only by subjects bound to the metrics-reader ClusterRole. |
| `admissionPolicy.enabled` | `true` | Make the API server reject AccessRequests that name someone other than their creator. See docs/guides/how-to-set-up-login.md. |
